recipes.title: Big Rusty Drums groove
recipes.intent: Kick, snare, hats and a tom fill from Big Rusty Drums (CC0, referenced, FLAC fetched on play).
recipes.code:
setcpm(90/4)
$: s("brd_kick ~ brd_kick ~, ~ brd_snare ~ brd_snare, brd_hat_closed*8").gain(1.45)
$: s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ brd_tom brd_tom").gain(1.45)

recipes.title: Gogodze Phu groove
recipes.intent: Kick, snare, closed and open hats from Gogodze Phu Vol II (CC0, referenced).
recipes.code:
setcpm(95/4)
$: s("gog_kick ~ ~ gog_kick, ~ gog_snare ~ gog_snare, gog_hat_closed*8").gain(1.4)
$: s("~ ~ ~ gog_hat_open").gain(1.4)

recipes.title: Gogodze Phu tom pattern
recipes.intent: Three toms from Gogodze Phu Vol II (CC0, referenced).
